text: # CollaborateLive: Real-Time Editing for Remote Teams A lightweight, production-ready tool for real-time document collaboration, built with React and WebSockets. Enables seamless teamwork across time zones with live sync, version history, and granular permissions. Ideal for startups needing rapid iteration without compromising performance. ## Getting Started 1. Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/yourusername/collaborate.live.git` 2. Install dependencies: `npm install` 3. Run the dev server: `npm start` 4. Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser ## Usage - **Live Editing**: Multiple users edit the same document simultaneously with cursor indicators and conflict resolution. - **Chat & @ Mentions**: Inline messaging for real-time communication. - **Version History**: Revert to any previous state with a single click. - **Permissions**: Granular access controls via role-based UI components.
